items.title: 2.2.1.5 Handling Integer and Float Inputs (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of integer and float input (PDF 37).

blocks.text: input() hamesha text lautata hai. Input ko adad ke taur par istemal karne ke liye poore adad ke liye int() ya aasharia ke liye float() se badlein.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
# Integer input
user_age = int(input("Enter your age: "))
print("Your age is:", user_age)
# Float input
user_height = float(input("Enter your height in meters: "))
print("Your height is", user_height, "meters")

blocks.prompt: Agar program int(input(...)) chalaye aur user 1.75 likhe to kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: int() text '1.75' ko nahi badal sakta, to Python ValueError deti hai; aasharia qeematon ke liye float(input(...)) istemal karna chahiye.

items: Input text ko poore adad ke liye int() aur aasharia ke liye float() se badlein.
